Directory Opus 5 - file manager for AmigaOS 3
=============================================

Upstream Directory Opus 5 5.104 (the open-source release), unmodified, for Amarchy's DOpus menu and
hotkeys. Optional: the base kit never needs it. Install runs upstream's own installer with the build for
your CPU (68000 or 68010: the os3-68000 build; 68020 and newer: the os3 build). A Directory Opus that is
already installed (DOpus5: assigned) is never touched: Install says so and stops.
Uninstall removes only this archive's record; delete the DOpus5: drawer by hand if you want it gone.
